claims: Jack Nicklaus, Gary Player, and Tom Watson served as the honorary starters for the 2026 Masters.
Jack Nicklaus, Gary Player, and Tom Watson teed off on Thursday, April 9, 2026.
Jack Nicklaus, Gary Player, and Tom Watson teed off to officially begin the 90th edition of the 2026 Masters.
The 2026 Masters took place at Augusta National.
Jack Nicklaus, Gary Player, and Tom Watson continued their tradition of opening the Masters.
